messages:
noah (new hire): Hi team, first week here. My monitor arrived but the USB-C power brick wasn’t included, and my laptop only charges via PD. Anyone able to help with a spare brick or temporary loaner? Also noticed the Wi-Fi in the kitchen nook (near Desk 6.2) keeps dropping when I grab coffee.

megan (IT): welcome Noah! :wave: sorry about that. Can you share the monitor model and the laptop model? I can either send a spare PD brick or drop a universal charger. I’ll also open a ticket for the Wi-Fi.

noah (new hire): Monitor: Dell U2723QE. Laptop: Lenovo X1 Carbon Gen 11. I can take a universal charger if you have one.

kai (office ops): we have a USB-C 90W PD universal brick in the supply cabinet. i can swing by and drop it at your desk. leave a sticky if you step away.

megan (IT): created ticket IT-2026-5017 for missing brick and flaky AP. Noah, could you note approximate times the Wi-Fi dropped so networking can check logs? Also please upload the photo of the monitor box/label to the ticket.

noah (new hire): Uploaded pic and added times: 08:42, 08:55, and 09:10 while on Google Meet.

wifi-bot: Scanning AP logs for 6th floor. Found assoc/deauth events on AP-6F-NOOK at 08:42:15 and 09:09:58. AP shows high client count (72) during peak. Recommended: move some devices to AP-6F-EDGE or schedule channel rebalancing tonight.

kai (office ops): dropping the 90W PD brick at Desk 6.2 now. left a note.

megan (IT): Networking scheduled rebalancing at 22:00 tonight; will monitor post-change. Ticket IT-2026-5017 updated. Noah, confirm if the charger works and whether Wi-Fi improves tomorrow and then I’ll close the ticket.

noah (new hire): Charger received and charges laptop fine, thanks! Wi-Fi seems stable this morning too. Appreciate the quick help.

megan (IT): great, closing IT-2026-5017. Welcome to Redwood!
